name: UserForm
description: A form to create or edit a user: name, email, role, status and team, with a danger zone for suspending and deleting. Save stays disabled until something changes, and Cancel asks before throwing changes away. Your onSubmit does the work. UI permission is not security: the server must check again.

mode.description: create starts empty and shows no danger zone. edit makes the email read-only, with a hint, and shows the danger zone.

defaultValues.tsType: Partial<{ name: string; email: string; role: string; status: "active" | "suspended"; team: string | null }>
defaultValues.description: The starting values. Only read when the form mounts; give it a key to start over.

roles.tsType: Array<{ id: string; label: string; description?: string }>
roles.description: The roles a user can have. The description of the chosen role is shown under its Select.

teams.description: The teams a user can belong to. Without teams the team field is left out.

title.description: A heading for the form. Leave it out when the form sits in a Sheet that already has a title.

headingLevel.description: Heading level of the title, 1 to 6.

layout.description: card draws a bordered card with padding; plain has no chrome, for a Sheet or a page that already has one.

submitLabel.description: The text of the Save button. Default: "Create user" or "Save changes".

successMessage.description: Announced and shown when onSubmit worked.

dangerZone.description: More actions for the danger zone, shown next to Suspend and Delete user. Edit mode only.

onSubmit.tsType: (values: { name: string; email: string; role: string; status: "active" | "suspended"; team: string | null }) => void | import("../form/form").SubmitResult | Promise<void | import("../form/form").SubmitResult>
onSubmit.description: Saves the user; yours, async. Return { fieldErrors } to show a server problem on a field (for example email) or { formError } for the whole form.

onCancel.description: Called when the person cancels. With unsaved changes it is called after they confirm Discard.

onDelete.description: Deletes the user; yours. The Delete user button asks first. Without it the button is left out.

onSuspend.description: Suspends the user right away; yours. The Suspend button asks first. Without it the button is left out.

permissions.description: What the app allows: edit (the whole form, and Suspend), delete (Delete user) and changeRole (the role field). Hidden removes it; disabled makes a field read-only but focusable with the reason as its description, and a button stays focusable with the reason. This only changes what people see: the server must check again.

classNames.description: Extra class names for single parts, so you can restyle one part without editing the file. Keys: root, header, title, form, fields, actions, saveButton, cancelButton, dangerZone, status.

keyboard: Tab: moves through name, email, role, status, team, Cancel and Save, then the danger zone
Enter in a text field: saves
Escape: with unsaved changes asks "Discard changes?"; without them it does nothing here
Delete user and Suspend open a confirmation that you answer with Tab and Enter
requirements: Save is disabled until a value changes
Cancel with unsaved changes opens an alert dialog; Keep editing returns focus to where it was
A failed save moves focus to the error summary; each item moves to its field
A field the person may not change is read-only, stays focusable, and its description gives the reason
The email in edit mode is read-only with a hint saying why
The danger zone is a labelled group, so it is announced as its own part of the page
screenReader: "Email, edit text, read only" with "Email cannot be changed here"
"Active, switch, on" with "Suspended users cannot sign in"

use_when: Creating a user, or editing one in a Sheet, a page or a card
avoid_when: Inviting several people by email: use InviteDialog
Editing your own profile and password: use a settings page
anti_patterns: Treating the permissions prop as protection: UI permission is not security, so the server must check again
Hiding a field the person may see but not change: use disabled with a reason
Closing a Sheet around the form in a way that skips onCancel, which loses the Discard changes question

contract.data: The user's current values (defaultValues), the roles and teams to choose from, and async onSubmit, onDelete and onSuspend.
customization: mode, layout, title, submitLabel and successMessage
